hook.text: Some children are born without a working immune system. A common cold can kill them.

buildup.text: Primary immunodeficiencies are genetic. SCID, known as 'bubble boy' disease, leaves patients with virtually no immunity.

discovery.text: Secondary immunodeficiency is more common: chemotherapy, malnutrition, or chronic stress can all weaken immune function.

twist.text: Sleep deprivation halves vaccine effectiveness. A single night of poor sleep measurably suppresses immune cell counts.

climax.text: Immunity isn't fixed. It fluctuates with genetics, health, stress, and sleep. Everyone's shield has weak points.

punchline.text: Your immune system is only as strong as your worst habits.

quiz.question: What is SCID?
options: A genetic condition leaving patients with nearly no immune system
An allergic reaction to environmental toxins
